BANNER.ADMIN_ONLY_AUTOMATIONS: Only administrators can edit classic automations.

WORKFLOW.DESCRIPTION: Build journeys with triggers, waits, and automatic actions.

CREATE.TITLE: How do you want to start?
CREATE.DESC: Create a blank flow or pick a ready-made template to customize.
CREATE.BLANK_DESC: Start from scratch with an empty diagram.
CREATE.TEMPLATES_DESC: Choose a pre-built flow and customize it.
CREATE.GALLERY_DESC: Templates create an inactive flow you can review before activating.
CREATE.TEMPLATE_CREATE_ERROR: Could not create flow from template.
CREATE.CONNECT_FORM_CONTEXT: Link form "{name}" to a service flow.

LIST.EMPTY: No flows yet. Create the first one to automate customer service.
LIST.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load flows. Check your connection.
LIST.CONFLICT_WARNING: Warning: Active classic automations share the same trigger and may duplicate actions — {names}. Consider disabling the v1 automations.

DELETE_MODAL.TITLE: Delete flow
DELETE_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: This flow will be removed permanently. You cannot undo this action.

ACTIVATE_MODAL.TITLE: Activate Service Flow
ACTIVATE_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: This flow may send automatic messages to customers.

EDITOR.UNSAVED_LEAVE_CONFIRM: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
EDITOR.NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name before saving the flow.
EDITOR.INTENT_REQUIRED: Select an intent before saving the flow
EDITOR.INTENT_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Detail what the AI should recognize…
EDITOR.INTENT_DESCRIPTION_HINT: Refines the match criteria. Uses default description if empty.
EDITOR.INTENT_HELP_TOOLTIP: Only advances when intent matches. Empty/repeated messages are ignored.
EDITOR.AI_PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Follow up about the pending quote
EDITOR.AI_ANALYSIS_HINT: The AI will analyze up to 100 messages. Private note uses the channel webhook; external WhatsApp sends a summary to the configured number.
EDITOR.VALIDATION_HINT: Nodes with errors are highlighted in red on the diagram.
EDITOR.ACTIVE_READONLY: Deactivate the flow to edit the diagram.
EDITOR.PALETTE_HINT: Drag or click to add to canvas
EDITOR.STEP_LABEL_HINT: Optional · shown in the conversation timeline
EDITOR.AGENT_CANCEL_SECTION: Cancellation on agent reply or label
EDITOR.CANCEL_ON_AGENT_REPLY_HINT: Useful for follow-up flows: when an agent takes over, the flow stops.
EDITOR.CANCEL_ON_LABELS_HINT: If any of these labels is added to the conversation, the flow is cancelled.
EDITOR.REENROLLMENT_HINT: Allows a contact to enter this flow again after completing or cancelling it.
EDITOR.REENROLLMENT_INTERVAL_HINT: Minimum days since last exit before allowing re-entry. Set 0 for no interval.
EDITOR.REENROLLMENT_MAX_HINT: Maximum total times a contact can enter this flow. Set 0 for unlimited.
EDITOR.REENROLLMENT_ON_CANCEL_HINT: If unchecked, only completed (not cancelled) enrollments allow re-entry.
EDITOR.WAIT_HINT: The flow waits for this period before the next step.
EDITOR.WAIT_FOR_REPLY_HINT: Connect Then (Replied) when there is a response and Else (No reply) when the deadline expires.
EDITOR.WHATSAPP_EXTERNAL_HINT: Sends an external alert via WhatsApp Web (API). Does not open a ManyTalks conversation.
EDITOR.WHATSAPP_TEST_ERROR: Could not send test. Check channel and number.
EDITOR.WHATSAPP_NO_INBOX: No WhatsApp Web (API) channel available on this account.
EDITOR.EDGE_DUPLICATE_BRANCH: This branch output already has a connection.
EDITOR.PAUSE_ON_REPLY_HINT: Does not apply while the flow is on a Wait for reply node (branches automatically).
EDITOR.FLOW_SETTINGS_HINT: Automatic cancellation and global Service Flow behavior.
EDITOR.SELECT_NODE_HINT: Select a node on the canvas to edit.
EDITOR.FORM_TRIGGER_INBOX_HINT: Required to create a conversation when the lead has no open conversation yet.
EDITOR.FORM_TRIGGER_FORMS_HINT: Select one or more published forms that trigger this flow.
EDITOR.FORM_TRIGGER_FORMS_EMPTY: No published forms. Publish a form in the Forms tab first.
EDITOR.CONDITION_HINT: All conditions must match (AND). Connect Then and Else branches on the canvas.
EDITOR.FLOW_CONDITION_HINT: Evaluates the current conversation state. Same filters as v1 automations, plus labels, assignee, and dates.
EDITOR.RESPECT_BUSINESS_HOURS_HINT: Messages scheduled outside business hours are rescheduled to the next valid slot.
EDITOR.ENROLL_LATEST_ONLY: Enroll only in the contact's most recent conversation
EDITOR.ENROLL_LATEST_ONLY_HINT: When a contact has multiple open conversations, the flow starts only in the most recently updated one.

REGUA.TITLE: Service Flow
REGUA.MODAL_EMPTY: Start an automated follow-up flow for this conversation.
REGUA.MODAL_EMPTY_HINT: Pick an active flow and track each step in real time.
REGUA.MODAL_ACTIVE: Manage pause, resume, and stages for the active flow.
REGUA.EMPTY: No active flow for this conversation.
REGUA.ERROR_CONFLICT: An active flow already exists. Pause or end it first.
REGUA.ERROR_INACTIVE: This flow is inactive. Ask an administrator to activate it.
REGUA.ERROR_FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to manage flows in this conversation.
REGUA.ERROR_GENERIC: Could not complete the action. Please try again.

CANCEL_MODAL.TITLE: End flow?
CANCEL_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: The automatic follow-up will stop. You can start another flow later.

JUMP_MODAL.TITLE: Jump to stage?
JUMP_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Timers will be recalculated from the selected stage.

REGUA.NO_ACTIVE_WORKFLOWS: No active flows available. Activate one under Settings → Service Flow.
REGUA.REBIND_CROSS_INBOX_WARNING: Selected conversation is from another inbox. Send times follow the linked inbox.

VALIDATION.NOT_REACHABLE: This step is not connected to the start of the flow.
VALIDATION.NO_OUTBOUND: Connect this step to the next step in the flow.
VALIDATION.CONDITION_BRANCHES: Connect both Then and Else outputs for this condition.
VALIDATION.WAIT_REPLY_BRANCHES: Connect both Replied and No reply outputs.
VALIDATION.WHATSAPP_PHONE_INVALID: The phone number entered is invalid.
VALIDATION.WHATSAPP_INBOX_TYPE: Select a WhatsApp or WhatsApp Web (API) channel.
VALIDATION.INVALID_ACTION: Select a valid action for this step.
VALIDATION.FORM_TRIGGER_INBOX: Select an inbox on the form trigger.
VALIDATION.FORM_TRIGGER_INBOX_NOT_FOUND: The selected inbox was not found.
VALIDATION.FORM_TRIGGER_FORMS: Select at least one published form on the trigger.
VALIDATION.FORM_TRIGGER_FORMS_INVALID: One or more selected forms are not published.
VALIDATION.INVALID_WAIT_DURATION: Adjust the wait duration within the allowed range.
VALIDATION.INVALID_WAIT_RESPONDER: Select who should reply at this step.
VALIDATION.DEACTIVATE_TO_EDIT: Deactivate the flow to edit the diagram.
VALIDATION.CYCLE: The flow has a circular loop. Remove the connection that closes the cycle.
VALIDATION.TRIGGER_COUNT: The flow must have exactly one trigger.
VALIDATION.TRIGGER_INBOUND: No connection can enter the trigger node.
VALIDATION.AI_PROMPT: Enter the prompt for the AI step.
VALIDATION.AI_PROMPT_TOO_LONG: The AI prompt exceeds the maximum allowed length.
VALIDATION.AI_FEATURE_REQUIRED: Enable the AI module to use this step.
VALIDATION.EDGE_INCOMPLETE: There is an incomplete connection in the diagram.
VALIDATION.EDGE_UNKNOWN_NODE: A connection points to a step that does not exist.

SIMULATE.TITLE: Flow simulation
SIMULATE.SUBTITLE: Traverses the diagram without real side effects.
SIMULATE.EMPTY: Click Simulate to preview the flow path.
SIMULATE.NO_TRIGGER: The flow has no trigger configured.
SIMULATE.NO_NODES: No nodes found in the flow.
SIMULATE.RUN_ERROR: Failed to simulate. Please try again.
SIMULATE.TRUNCATED: Flow is very long — showing the first nodes only.

REPLY_RATE.LABEL: Reply rate
REPLY_RATE.TOOLTIP: Percentage of flows with contact reply
